name: services/slips/search_slips
description:
This method allows you to search among the list of all issued slips which your user has access to. You can use various filters in your search - they should allow you to use this method in many contexts.

Note: Slips visibility may depends on the scopes the user has provided access to you.

arguments.name: langpref
arguments.description:
A code of the preferred language ("pl" or "en"). It may influence the
	order and other display properties of the returned matches.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of slip fields you'd like to receive along the results. See the slip method for the list of valid values.

arguments.name: tpl_fields
arguments.description:
Deprecated. Use a subfield selector instead (e.g. fields=template[id]).

Pipe-separated list of template fields you'd like to receive in the template field. See the template method for the valid values.

arguments.name: my_role
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of user roles, as defined in the slip method. If given, the results will contain only these slips in which the current user "has" at least one of the referenced roles.

Note: Some roles (i.e. "template_admin") require access to higher scopes ("slips_admin") in order for the slips to become visible.

arguments.name: issued_by
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of user IDs. If given, the results will contain only these slips which were issued by one of the referenced users (the possible issuers of the slip).

arguments.name: issued_for
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of user IDs. If given, the results will contain only these slips which were issued for one of the referenced users (the possible clients of the slip).

arguments.name: state
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of slip states. If given, the results will contain
	only these slips which are in any of these states.

arguments.name: tpl_ids
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of template IDs. If given, the results will contain
	only these slips which were issued using any of the given templates.

arguments.name: fac_ids
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of faculty IDs. If given, the results will contain
	only these slips which were issued using a template bound to any of
	the given faculties.

arguments.name: programme_ids
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of study programme IDs. If given, the results will
	contain only these slips which were bound to any of the given study
	programmes.

arguments.name: num
arguments.description:
The number of search results to return. The maximum allowed value is
	100.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description:
The index of the first matching search result that is to be included
	in the response (zero-based).

arguments.name: order_by
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of fields to order by. This must be a subset of what you have given in your fields parameter. Each field reference might be preceded with a dash to indicate descending order. Currently allowed fields to order by:

  • state,
  • date_created.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • items - a list of matching slips. Each item is a slip object, as returned by the slip method. It will contain all the fields requested with the fields parameter (only id by default).

  • next_page - boolean, indicates if there is a next page of results for this query.
  • total - integer, a total number of matched items; if the number of matched items is huge, then USOS API may return an approximate count (especially if start is equal to 0).
